BiblicalUsage: Once, in the cities of the priests: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities. The name is a town in Benjamin given to the Levites, and the gift is all the Bible says of it.
TheologicalSignificance: A town named once in a list of priestly cities carries no lesson of its own. What it shows is the provision for the Levites, that the tribe with no land of its own was given towns scattered through the land.
